purpose: Deterministic admission policy for the quarantined backend recovery source. This policy is offline-only and grants no deployment capability.

required_remediations.rule: No admitted file may contain the legacy absolute workspace prefix; runtime and migration paths must resolve from the repository/module location or environment configuration.
Legacy database backups, generated database dumps, SQLite files, and database snapshots must not be committed. Tests must use synthetic fixtures only.
No fixed admin/bootstrap password, secret, API key, or credential may be admitted. Runtime credentials must come from environment-backed configuration.
Local media storage must use an environment-configurable or repository-relative path and retain path traversal protection.
